items.title: Need to learn how to create more chances on such wickets: Shanto
items.summary: Bangladesh had to settle for a draw in their one-off Test against Afghanistan after the hosts produced a brilliant batting display at the Zayed Cricket Stadium in Abu Dhabi.

items.summary: Bangladesh will aim for a consolatory strong finish when they face Australia in the final game of their three-match WODI series on Wednesday at Brisbane's Allan Border Field.

items.title: Sabbir Rahman ends eight-year first-class century drought
items.summary: Rajshahi Division’s Sabbir Rahman ended an eight-year wait for a first-class century to help his side secure a draw against Khulna Division on the final day of the second round of the National Cricket League at the Sher-e-Bangla National Cricket Stadium in Mirpur on Tuesday.

items.title: Atal century, lower-order resistence help Afghanistan hang on to a draw
items.summary: Bangladesh's missed chances especially in the final hour cost them as they couldn't pick up the last two wickets

items.title: Shanto disappointed but praises Afghanistan’s ‘brilliant cricket’
items.summary: “It is disappointing, but they played brilliantly. We couldn't take opportunities. The fast bowlers have been doing a very good job. I expected the spinners to come into the match; they tried, but Afghanistan played very good cricket,” Shanto said during the post-match presentation ceremony.

items.title: Nine dismissals, a century and a fifty: Litton sets world record on 32nd birthday
items.summary: On Day 5 of Bangladesh’s one-off Test against Afghanistan in Abu Dhabi today, Litton broke the record set by South Africa’s Denis Lindsay, who recorded eight dismissals and scored a half-century and a century in the same Test in 1966. Playing against Australia, Lindsay scored 69 and 182.
